title: Benchmarking LLM Next-Step Recommendations with Knowledge Space Theory
abstract: arXiv:2611.13667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selecting an LLM for next-step recommendation requires benchmarks that reflect the intended educational task and domain. We present a benchmarking method that uses Knowledge Space Theory (KST) as a formal evaluation reference. Given a task catalogue and an existing prerequisite relation, the method derives admissible knowledge states and the complete set of immediate next steps for each state. Recommendations generated by a model under a specified prompt are compared with these reference sets. A sample evaluation study uses 2,400 responses from six models across four mathematics domains, four prompt conditions, and two catalogue orders. Exact-set accuracy was 61.3% with descriptions only, 62.8% when models were asked to reconstruct prerequisites, 96.3% with supplied prerequisite relations, and 98.2% with the complete knowledge space. Performance varied across models and domains, and recommendation sets agreed across the two presentations

translated_title: 基于知识空间理论的大语言模型下一步推荐基准测试
translated_abstract: 为下一步推荐选择大语言模型（LLM）需要能够反映预期教育任务和领域的基准测试。我们提出了一种使用知识空间理论（KST）作为形式化评估参照的基准测试方法。给定任务目录和已有的先决条件关系，该方法推导出可接受的知识状态以及每个状态下完整的立即下一步集合。模型在指定提示词下生成的推荐将与这些参照集合进行比较。一项示例评估研究使用了来自六个模型的2,400条回复，涵盖四个数学领域、四种提示条件和两种目录顺序。结果显示：仅使用任务描述时精确集合准确率为61.3%，要求模型重建先决条件时为62.8%，提供先决条件关系时为96.3%，提供完整知识空间时为98.2%。性能在不同模型和领域之间存在差异，且推荐集合在两种目录呈现方式之间保持一致。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种以知识空间理论（KST）为形式化参照的基准测试方法来评估大语言模型在教育中的下一步推荐能力，实验表明提供知识空间结构信息（如先决条件关系或完整知识空间）可将推荐精确集合准确率从约61%大幅提升至96%以上。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a benchmarking method that uses Knowledge Space Theory (KST) as a formal evaluation reference to assess LLM next-step recommendations in education, demonstrating that supplying knowledge space structure information (prerequisite relations or the complete knowledge space) improves exact-set accuracy from ~61% to over 96%.
